spec.purpose: Observe all30 q8192 QKV-to-convolution consumer intervals while replaying every original projection candidate. The new whole provider adds only a default-off observer; adaptive OUT2, compact MoE1, exact attention, register PV, FLA, CLI and all original numerical bounds remain fixed. Each observation validates corrected endpoints and complete original convolution outputs using guarded temporary buffers. Require original8192 prompt IDs, all512 GB10 IDs, first-logit tolerance0.125 and every actual callback. Synchronization, private copies, duplicate convolution and counters change TTFT, so this is not a performance comparison or release qualification.

decision.decision: Keep this complete-consumer observer default off and do not implement correction omission in the current iteration. The all30-layer request passes the original GB10 boundary and every observed certificate, but only24.2350% of original QKV candidates are provisionally omittable, less than the layer0 capture. Original correction and the certificate itself both have nonzero cost; no net speedup was measured. With the retained uninstrumented TTFT still25.3794 seconds, prioritize a broader attention-compute replacement. These results remain evidence for a future materially improved consumer route, not a prohibition on revisiting it.

scope: One fresh real q8192/out512 process on the current compact-MoE1, adaptive-OUT2 and exact-attention stack with a newly built whole-provider observer. It executes every original QKV correction and duplicate private convolution before inspecting all30 linear layers. No candidate is omitted. All original prompt IDs,512 output IDs, actual callbacks and first logit pass the attached GB10 boundary. Every declared input interval and complete convolution output certificate agrees with original correction. Coverage is conditional on the unchanged empirical producer envelope and this measured request; no other prompt or continuation qualification follows.
timing_scope: TTFT includes observer allocation, private producer copies, certificate kernels, duplicate convolution, complete reductions, synchronization, readback and freeing. The per-layer owner clocks include original selected correction and are nested inside TTFT. They are not additive stage savings and cannot be compared with uninstrumented retained timing as a speedup. The805310592-byte transient observer owner is separate from model/runtime peak memory.
